title: MEME: discovering and analyzing DNA and protein sequence motifs
relevance: Foundational algorithm for motif discovery in biological sequences; provides the EM-based framework adapted here for binary string motif enrichment.

title: On the 3x+1 problem
relevance: Comprehensive database of known Collatz delay records, providing the primary dataset of 131 record-holding integers for motif analysis.

title: Biological sequence analysis
